title: Add playhouse.query_args for list endpoints
description: Adds `apply_args(query, args, fields, search=None, per_page=20, max_per_page=100)` in `playhouse/query_args.py`, so a list view can hand its query string straight to peewee: `<field>=<value>` and `<field>__<op>=<value>` filter (eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte with their usual meaning, `in` with a comma-separated list, `isnull` with true or false), `q` keeps the rows where any of the `search` fields contains the text ignoring case, with the text matched literally, `sort` takes comma-separated field names with `-` for descending, and `page` (from 1) and `per_page` paginate. The arguments come from the client, so only the fields the view lists in `fields` can be filtered or sorted on, `per_page` never goes above `max_per_page`, and anything else raises `ValueError` for the view to turn into a 400. Empty values are ignored, since browsers send empty form fields. Includes tests in `tests/query_args.py`.

defects.summary: sort looks names up among all of the model's fields instead of the allowed ones, so a client can sort on a field the view did not list, such as a password hash, and learn its values from the order.
The search text goes into a LIKE pattern without escaping, so % and _ in q act as wildcards instead of matching literally.
defects.corrected: return reduce(operator.or_, [field.contains(text) for field in fields])
defects.defective:
pattern = '%' + text + '%'
    return reduce(operator.or_, [field ** pattern for field in fields])

defects.summary: max_per_page only caps the default page size, so a client-supplied per_page is used as given and can fetch any number of rows.
The lte operator maps to operator.lt, so __lte excludes rows equal to the value.
isnull passes the string to is_null, and the string 'false' is truthy, so __isnull=false selects the rows that are null.

ceiling.summary: _positive only rejects 0, so a negative per_page gets through. min() keeps it below max_per_page and SQLite treats LIMIT -1 as no limit, so a client can fetch every row.

decoys.why: The client's value becomes a bound parameter of a peewee expression, never SQL text.

decoys.anchor: if key in RESERVED or value == '':
decoys.why: Ignoring empty values is the documented contract, because browsers submit empty form fields.
